# Gianluca Guidi

> Postdoc at Harvard, working with Francesca Dominici, after a PhD in AI for Social Sciences. I investigate the hidden costs of AI and what they mean for society and policy: the electricity, carbon and water of U.S. data centers, the air pollution and health effects of the power plants that run them, and who pays.

Website: https://gianguidi.github.io/

## What I work on

- Energy, carbon and water: the electricity use and carbon emissions of U.S. hyperscale data centers, and where they use water, on site and at the power plant.
- Health: the air pollution from the power plants behind AI, the mortality cost of keeping coal plants open for data centers, and power grids planned around health.
- People and justice: who pays for AI, and what it means for the communities living next to bitcoin mines or a proposed gas plant.

Interests: AI's energy, carbon and water use; who pays for AI; environmental justice; health equity; air pollution and public health; social justice; energy and climate policy; network science.

## Papers

- [Who Pays for Artificial Intelligence? Energy, Climate, and Health](https://ajph.aphapublications.org/doi/full/10.2105/AJPH.2026.308678): American Journal of Public Health, 2026
- [Assessing the Carbon Emissions and Energy Consumption of U.S. Hyperscale Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05420): accepted in Nature Sustainability, 2026
- [The environmental burden of the United States' bitcoin mining boom](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-58287-3): Nature Communications, 2025
- [The Hidden Water Geography of U.S. Hyperscale Data Centers in the AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02531): arXiv, 2026
- [Environmental Burden of United States Data Centers in the AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.09786): arXiv, 2024
- [Delayed Coal Plant Retirements in the Era of Data Centers Carry a Measurable Mortality Cost](https://europepmc.org/article/pmc/pmc13648786): medRxiv, 2026
- [Public Health and Economic Burden of a Proposed 3,500-MW Natural Gas Plant in Virginia](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7350551): SSRN, 2026 (the plant was withdrawn)
- [Tracing two decades of carbon emissions using a network approach](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-57351-0): Scientific Reports, 2024
- [Towards a Health-Based Power Grid Optimization in the AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09029): arXiv, 2024
- The Global Carbon Trade Network: working paper

## Data and code

- [Hyperscalers Emissions and Energy Consumption in the US](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/SKKTAG): Harvard Dataverse
- [hyperscale-emissions](https://github.com/gianguidi/hyperscale-emissions): electricity and carbon of U.S. hyperscale data centers
- [hyperscale-water-geography](https://github.com/gianguidi/hyperscale-water-geography): their water, on site and at the power plant
- [bitcoin_mining_env_burden](https://github.com/gianguidi/bitcoin_mining_env_burden): electricity, PM2.5 and communities near U.S. bitcoin mines
